summary: Daily agent/agent-infra sweep: three vendor releases (Copilot, Claude Code, Cloudflare Computer), DeepSeek security/perf alert, rising infra (agentdock, livekit), and multiple user-workflow signals about long-lived sessions, secret-leak experiments, and new MCP integrations.
